criticalInterpretations.expandedGit: Actual Git Changes/diff expansion increases its height. Village deliberately pauses for limited space and releases its iframe; collapsing Changes restores a real rendered Village frame and unchanged world. This is not evidence of simultaneous Village rendering while the expanded Git pane leaves insufficient space.
criticalInterpretations.live2d: Production data-capability=animated is observed and static fallback image hidden, before and after Sidebar restoration.
criticalInterpretations.drag05: Original PASS result is retained unchanged but overridden NOT_ACCEPTED_FALSE_POSITIVE: mouse path 2.138 CSS pixels was below the 5px drag threshold; prior position was already within target tolerance. It is excluded from accepted drag evidence.
criticalInterpretations.drag06: Accepted run asserts CSS distance >20, production gesture actor+moved, actual displacement >20, same resident ID, target error <6, exact operation/revision state readback and unchanged memories/membership/draft. Tolerance covers live movement between durable sample and pointerdown; never substitutes for displacement/gesture.
criticalInterpretations.saveAcknowledgement: Electron custom dsh-app protocol does not expose response bodies through CDP Network.getResponseBody. Test observes real HTTP200 save and immediately reads official state to verify operationId equality and revision=expectedRevision+1; no replay writes or forged DOM/world.
